_readme: Every visible string of the checkout page (/checkout/ and the hidden /checkout-test/), in English. tools/build_i18n.py makes each one an OPTIONAL i18n key co.<key> (todo / merge / blind / merge-back translate them like the rest of the site), and tools/build_pages.py writes /checkout/i18n/<lang>.json: the translation where it has passed the checks, the English otherwise (shown marked lang="en"). privacyNote, deliveryNote, returnsNote and grievanceNote are NOT here: their English is TERMS in checkout-worker/src/seller.js (shared with the order e-mail), and the build adds them as co.<key> too. Placeholders in {braces} stay exactly as they are; numbers stay Western digits.

pageTitle.note: browser tab title of the checkout page; keep '1acrefarms' as written

back.note: link at the top of the checkout page, back to our website

title.note: main heading of the page where the buyer reviews the order, types the address and pays

bannerTest.en: TEST MODE: no real money is taken. This page is hidden and only for testing.
bannerTest.note: notice shown only while payments are in test mode

bannerLive.note: notice on our internal test copy of the page: real payments are being taken

bannerOff.en: Online payment is switched off right now.
bannerOff.note: notice when the payment system is turned off

bannerUnreachable.en: The payment server cannot be reached right now.
bannerUnreachable.note: notice when our payment server does not answer

packsTitle.note: heading of step 1: the packs in the cart

packMeta.en: {grams} g · MRP {price} (incl. of all taxes) · {unit} per g · {details}
packMeta.note: one line under each pack name: weight, price incl. all taxes, price per gram, then a link; keep MRP and every {placeholder}

packDetails.note: link to the product page with the full details printed on the pack

less.note: label read out for the minus button that lowers the quantity of a pack; {name} = the pack

more.note: label read out for the plus button that raises the quantity of a pack; {name} = the pack

linkIgnored.en: Not added from the link (not available to order here now): {items}.
linkIgnored.note: note when a shared shopping link named packs we cannot sell here; {items} = product codes

linkClampedLine.en: Up to {max} of the same pack per order: a quantity from the link was lowered.
linkClampedLine.note: note when a shared shopping link asked for more of one pack than one order can take

linkClampedTotal.en: Up to {max} packs per order: some packs from the link were not added.
linkClampedTotal.note: note when a shared shopping link asked for more packs than one order can take

addressTitle.note: heading of step 2: where to deliver

fEmail.note: form label; we e-mail the order confirmation here

fAddress.note: form label for the street address

fState.note: form label (Indian state or union territory)

fStatePick.note: first, empty choice of the state list

fPin.note: form label: the 6-digit Indian postal code

privacyLink.note: link text inside the privacy note under the address form

err.name.invalid.en: Please enter your name in letters (up to 60).

err.phone.invalid.en: Please enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.

err.address.too_short.en: Please add your house number, street and area.

err.address.invalid.en: Please keep the address under 200 characters, without < or >.
err.address.invalid.note: form error; keep the characters < and > as they are

err.city.required.en: Please enter your city or town.

err.city.invalid.en: Please enter the city name in letters (up to 30).

err.state.invalid.en: Please choose your state from the list.

err.pin.invalid.en: Please enter a valid 6-digit PIN code.

err.pin.state_mismatch.en: This PIN code is not in the state you chose. Please check both.

err.items.empty_cart.en: Please add at least one pack.
err.items.empty_cart.note: error when the cart is empty

err.items.qty_over_limit.en: Up to {max} of the same pack per order.
err.items.qty_over_limit.note: error: too many of one pack

err.items.too_many_packs.en: Up to {max} packs per order. For more, please place a second order.
err.items.too_many_packs.note: error: too many packs in one order

err.items.not_sellable.en: A pack in your cart is not available now. Please remove it.

err.items.unknown_item.en: A pack in your cart is not available now. Please remove it.

summaryTitle.note: heading of step 3: totals and pay

sumPacks.note: summary row: number of packs, then their price

sumGstIntra.en: GST included in the MRP: {tax} (CGST {half}% {cgst} + SGST {half}% {sgst})
sumGstIntra.note: tax line for delivery inside Andhra Pradesh; the tax is already inside the price, nothing is added; keep GST, CGST, SGST, MRP

sumGstInter.note: tax line for delivery outside Andhra Pradesh; already inside the price; keep GST, IGST, MRP

sumGstNoState.note: tax line before a state is chosen; keep GST, MRP

sumDelivery.note: summary row label: the delivery charge

sumDeliveryFree.note: the delivery charge, always ₹0: delivery is free anywhere in India

sumEmpty.en: Your cart is empty. Add a pack above.
sumEmpty.note: shown when the cart is empty

sumMrpOnly.en: You pay the MRP only. Nothing is added at checkout.
sumMrpOnly.note: plain fact under the total: the price printed on the pack is all the buyer pays

prepaidNote.en: Prepaid only: UPI, debit or credit card, net banking or wallet. No cash on delivery. Payments are handled by Razorpay (Cashfree and PhonePe as backups); we never see your card details or UPI PIN.
prepaidNote.note: payment methods; keep UPI, PIN, Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe in Latin letters

deliveryTitle.note: small heading before the delivery terms

returnsTitle.note: small heading before the cancellation and refund terms

sellerTitle.note: small heading before the seller's legal name and addresses

footTitle.note: heading of the page footer with the seller's details

gstin.note: the seller's GST number; keep GSTIN

fssaiReg.note: food safety registration number; keep FSSAI

fssaiLic.note: food safety licence number; keep FSSAI

careLine.en: Customer care and grievance officer: {name}, {designation} · {phone} (call or WhatsApp) · {email}
careLine.note: the one person who answers questions and handles complaints (Indian consumer law); keep WhatsApp in Latin letters

policiesLink.en: Seller details, terms of sale, shipping, returns and privacy

terms.en: By paying you agree to our {link}.
terms.note: line above the Pay button; {link} = the next string, as a link

termsLink.en: terms of sale, shipping and refund policies
termsLink.note: link text inside the line above

pay.note: the pay button; {amount} = the total in rupees

payEmpty.note: the pay button while the cart is empty

payBusy.note: the pay button while the payment starts

creating.note: status while the payment window is being prepared

redirecting.en: Taking you to PhonePe to pay…
redirecting.note: status before moving to PhonePe's payment page; keep PhonePe

verifying.note: status while we check the payment

priceChangedTitle.note: heading when our server's total differs from the page's

priceChangedBody.en: The total for this order is {amount}. Please check it and press Pay again.

successTitle.en: Thank you! Your payment is received.

successBody.en: Order number: {id}. We pack and dispatch within 1–2 working days (not on Sundays or public holidays) and send the courier name and tracking link on WhatsApp or email.
successBody.note: after payment; keep the numbers 1 and 2, keep WhatsApp

successKeep.en: Please keep the order number for any question.

pendingTitle.note: heading while a payment is still being confirmed

pendingBody.en: Order number: {id}. If money has left your account, there is no need to pay again: we confirm it within a few minutes, and a payment that does not complete is refunded automatically.
pendingBody.note: reassurance while the payment is confirmed

failedBody.en: No money was taken for this attempt. You can try again, or order from our Amazon.in store.
failedBody.note: after a failed payment; keep Amazon.in in Latin letters

failedReason.en: Reason given by the bank or app: {reason}
failedReason.note: {reason} is the bank's own message, in English

cancelledTitle.note: heading when the buyer closed the payment window

cancelledBody.en: Nothing was charged. Your cart is saved: press Pay to try again.
cancelledBody.note: after the payment window was closed

errorTitle.en: We could not start the payment
errorTitle.note: heading when the payment could not start

errorBody.en: Please try again in a minute, or order from our Amazon.in store.

disabledTitle.en: Online payment is off right now
disabledTitle.note: heading when online payment is switched off

disabledBody.en: Please order from our Amazon.in store. For help, message us on WhatsApp.
disabledBody.note: keep Amazon.in and WhatsApp in Latin letters

outOfStock.en: {name} has just sold out. Please lower the quantity or remove it.

amazon.note: button to our store on Amazon.in; keep Amazon.in in Latin letters

help.note: button: ask us for help on WhatsApp (help only, not for placing orders); keep WhatsApp

waHelp.en: Hi 1acrefarms, I need help with the checkout on your website.
waHelp.note: first line of the WhatsApp help message the buyer sends us; keep 1acrefarms

rzpDescription.note: short line shown in the payment window
